propositions: Broad exception handling in _assemble_context_uncached silently swallows list_tickets and per-child show_ticket failures, leaving PlanContext.children empty without recording the failure.

Empty children list causes PlanContext.has_children to evaluate False, which suppresses container-scoped DET checks (p5_task_dag, p8_reviewability) and produces unqualified PASS verdicts despite incomplete hierarchy context.

Five finalize_verdict call sites (two in workflow_ops.py, three in gate_dispatch.py) must thread hierarchy_incomplete and hierarchy_incomplete_detail flags through the coverage dict to propagate incomplete-context signal to verdict decisions.

plan_review_coach workflow step reads hierarchy context flags only from ctx.inputs (sourced from plan_review_precheck's output), requiring both YAML with: block extensions and precheck's output dict to include these fields.

drift_floor._recompute_verdict_after_drop must recognize hierarchy_incomplete in coverage and preserve INDETERMINATE verdict when re-deriving after drops, across all three call sites (drift_floor.apply_to_verdict, xcheck.apply_contradiction_drops, xcheck.apply_comment_trail_drops).
